evidence.note: Real ERP УХ 3.2.12.6 1cv8.cf storage entries, extracted with `ibcmd-rs cf extract <cf> <form-uuid>.0 <outdir>` (compression raw-deflate). Both forms carry a built-in Navigator/quick-search child item, which writes one extra field between the root child-items count-list and the classic 24-member form-root trailer -- a 25-member trailer, not 24. The pre-fix parser (`form_root_child_items_tail_start`, root `50` + trailer `[24]` only) found no valid count-list at all for either form and silently dropped the whole `<MobileDeviceCommandBarContent>` block (doctrine point 2/6: a silent default, not a typed refusal). Confirmed on two more native forms not included as fixtures here (Catalogs/ВерсииФайлов/Forms/ФормаВыбора uuid 2d86d1fc-5367-47b8-804e-7f9c5fc8f3b1, CommonForms/ФормаОтчета uuid 9d6d77a9-1f55-4162-93a5-14bb3f3febaf) -- all four validate cleanly at `fields.len() - 25` via the existing shared count-list scan (`form_root_child_items_tail_start_at`), and in every case the resulting trailer's second-to-last field (not a fixed absolute slot) is the `{50,<count>,"",...}` MobileDeviceCommandBarContent content tuple.
